descFull: DomoDomo is a 100% client-side, Agentic offline-first web utility application. Built as a high-performance, private, zero-server architecture toolbox, all operations run completely inside your browser sandbox. Your data, images, PDFs, and files never leave your computer no servers, no APIs, and no external clouds are ever touched.
